title: Which blank in this pyramid can we fill first?
description: A pyramid with the top ten, the middle row four and a blank, and the bottom row one and two blanks is filled by taking away. Each blank is found from a block and the block next to it, and the pyramid is checked going up. Keeko doubts that the middle blank is fourteen.
teaching_notes: One idea: a block with one known block below it gives the other block below by taking away. Watch for students who add the known numbers, forgetting that a block below is only a part of the block above.

source: How do we fill this pyramid?
video_script.why: A child fills a pyramid with blank blocks by taking away from the block above, then checks it by adding going up.
video_script.substitution: the book's own pyramid with the top ten, filled by taking away and checked going up
video_script.anchor: a pyramid with the top 10, the middle row 4 and a blank, and the bottom row 1 and two blanks
video_script.wrong_move: adds the known numbers because pyramids are about adding, forgetting that a block below is only a part of the block above
video_script.payoff_line: The middle row is four and six, and the bottom row is one, three and three.

final_answer.spoken: the middle row is four and six, and the bottom row is one, three and three

maths_rules: Below the 4 sit 1 and a blank, so the blank is 4 - 1 = 3.
Below the 6 sit 3 and the last blank, so it is 6 - 3 = 3.
video_script.design: One idea: a block take away its known neighbour gives the other block below. The pyramid stays in the anchor band and each blank is filled on the working board.

beats.on_screen: the small title card From your book appears; a pyramid with the top 10, the middle row 4 and a blank, and the bottom row 1 and two blanks stands in the anchor band

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.pyr: the pyramid with its filled blocks and three blanks appears
marks.ask: the words which blank first? are written

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book. It shows a pyramid with some blocks missing.
<bookmark mark='pyr'/>The top is ten. The middle row is four and a blank, and the bottom row is one and two blanks.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The rule is the same as before. Which blank can we fill first?

beats.on_screen: the pyramid holds still and the three blanks glow

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a small pyramid: a block 7 above, a block 3 below on the left, and a blank below on the right; 7 - 3 = 4 is written

marks.known: a block 7 is shown with 3 below it and a blank next to the 3

narration: <bookmark mark='known'/>A block holds the sum of the two blocks below it. One of those two is found by taking away.
<bookmark mark='take'/>With seven above and three below, the other block below is seven take away three, which is four.

beats.on_screen: Given: top 10; middle row 4 and a blank; bottom row 1 and two blanks

marks.given: the top, the middle row and the bottom row are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the top is ten. The middle row is four and a blank, and the bottom row is one and two blanks.

beats.on_screen: To find: the three blank blocks

marks.find: the thing to find is written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the three blank blocks.

marks.top: the top 10 is joined to 4 and the middle blank
marks.six: 10 - 4 = 6 is written in the middle blank

narration: <bookmark mark='top'/>Step one, the top ten rests on four and the middle blank.
<bookmark mark='six'/>The blank is ten take away four, which is six.

beats.on_screen: 4 - 1 = 3: the bottom blank under the 4 is 3

marks.four: the 4 is joined to 1 and a bottom blank
marks.three: 4 - 1 = 3 is written in the bottom blank

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step two, the four rests on one and a blank.
<bookmark mark='three'/>The blank is four take away one, which is three.

marks.six: the 6 is joined to 3 and the last blank
marks.three: 6 - 3 = 3 is written in the last blank

narration: <bookmark mark='six'/>Step three, the six rests on three and the last blank.
<bookmark mark='three'/>The blank is six take away three, which is three.

marks.top: 4 + 6 = 10 is written and ticked beside the top 10

narration: <bookmark mark='mid'/>Step four, check going up. One plus three is four, and three plus three is six.
<bookmark mark='top'/>Four plus six is ten, which matches the top.

beats.on_screen: Answer: middle row 4 and 6; bottom row 1, 3 and 3
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The middle row is four and six, and the bottom row is one, three and three.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 10 + 4 = 14 in the middle blank; a test shows 4 + 14 = 18 beside the top 10; the bubble is struck out

marks.doubt: Keeko's bubble 10 + 4 = 14 appears in the middle blank

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the middle blank is fourteen, adding ten and four.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it. Four plus fourteen makes eighteen, but the top block says ten.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A block below is only a part of the block above, so it must be smaller.
